verdict.rationale: Helicone's own background automations are narrow, event-driven features rather than general user-defined automations. Alerts continuously monitor error rates and costs with filters and notify via Slack or email automatically. Filtered webhooks fire on request completion to trigger downstream workflows and real-time scoring, though the workflow itself runs in the user's own system. Missing for 10: general-purpose user-defined automations or scheduled/recurring jobs, autonomous agent runs executed by Helicone itself, and any hands-on or independent corroboration of these automation features.
